name: Unstable Column (1-2)
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: Plaster crumbles from this column moments before it collapses.
disable: DC 16 Crafting check (trained) to stabilize the column, DC 19 Athletics check to push the column back into place

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps on the tiles adjacent to the column

Effect The column collapses. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 16 basic Reflex save as debris falls on them, which deals 2d6+3 bludgeoning damage. The area adjacent to the collapsed column becomes difficult terrain.
